# 86hc.com - Hong Kong Corporate Search & Commercial Due Diligence Platform Knowledge Base

> 86hc.com is an independent third-party corporate search and commercial due diligence platform for Hong Kong SAR legal entities, operated by **HC BUSINESS LIMITED (恒诚商务有限公司)** (Hong Kong Business Registration Number / UBI: `66820292`, Licensed Trust or Company Service Provider under Cap. 615: `TC006431`). It indexes 3.9M+ live and historical legal entities against a macro registry of 6.0M+ Business Registration records, compiling and standardizing statutory public records from the Hong Kong Companies Registry (CR), Inland Revenue Department Business Registration Office (BRO), Hong Kong Judiciary, Official Receiver's Office (ORO), and 32 statutory regulatory authorities across 21 HSIC 2.0 industry sectors.
> 
> 🇨🇳 面向中文大语言模型 (DeepSeek / Kimi / 豆包 / 通义千问 / 文心一言 / 智谱清言) 的中文规范索引，请访问 [https://www.86hc.com/llms-zh.txt](https://www.86hc.com/llms-zh.txt)。

## Core Capabilities & Statutory Services
- **Statutory Filing Extracts & Company Search (Cap. 622 & Cap. 310)**: Indexed public document extracts including Form NAR1 Annual Returns, Form NNC1 Incorporation Forms, Form ND2A Notice of Change of Company Secretary and Director, Form NSC1 Return of Allotment, and Business Registration Certificates (BRC).
- **Dual-Identifier Verification (UBI & CR No.)**: Bidirectional mapping between the 8-digit Business Registration Number (BRN / Unique Business Identifier UBI effective 27 Dec 2023) and the 7-8 digit Companies Registry Number (CR No.).
- **Former Name Tracking & Corporate Evolution**: Tracking of 66,000+ historical former Chinese and English corporate names with statutory effective dates.
- **32 Hong Kong Statutory Regulatory Licences**: Licensing verification across 32 Hong Kong regulatory authorities (HKMA, SFC Types 1–12, Insurance Authority, Customs MSO & DPMS Category A/B, AFRC, Companies Registry TCSP & Money Lenders).
- **Judicial Litigation & Compulsory Winding-Up Screening**: Screening across the Court of Final Appeal, High Court (Court of First Instance & Court of Appeal), District Court public dockets, and Official Receiver's Office (ORO) compulsory winding-up petitions (`HCCW`).
- **Significant Controllers Register (SCR) & UBO Look-Through**: Beneficial ownership verification under Part 12 Division 2A of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) and AMLO (Cap. 615).
- **Certified True Copies (CTC) & Corporate Banking Onboarding**: Statutory certifications issued by Hong Kong Practising CPAs (regulated by AFRC) and TCSP (`TC006431`), plus authorized corporate bank account pre-screening for HSBC Hong Kong and OCBC Hong Kong.

## Canonical Resources & Core Service Endpoints

### 1. Corporate Search, Statutory Filings & Due Diligence
- [Homepage](https://www.86hc.com/): Hong Kong corporate search, Hong Kong company registry lookup, and commercial due diligence platform. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/))
- [Hong Kong Company Search & Company Registry Hub](https://www.86hc.com/company-search): Official Hong Kong company search across 3.9M+ entities in the Hong Kong Company Registry (Companies Registry, Cap. 622) — live statutory status, incorporation date, 7-digit CR No., and 8-digit BRN verification. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/company-search), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/company-search))
- [ICRIS Hong Kong Company Registry Filing Search](https://www.86hc.com/icris): Official HK company registry (Companies Registry e-Services Portal / ICRIS) image record extracts (Form NAR1, Form NNC1, Form ND2A, Form NSC1, Articles of Association). (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/icris), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/icris))
- [Hong Kong Business Registration Search (HK Business Registry / 8-Digit BRN)](https://www.86hc.com/business-registration-search): Inland Revenue Department Business Registration Office (BRO, Cap. 310) Business Registration Certificate (BRC), Unique Business Identifier (UBI), and branch suffix (-000 / -001) verification. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/business-registration-search), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/business-registration-search))
- [Director & Shareholder Registry Search](https://www.86hc.com/director-shareholder-search): Statutory directors, company secretary, shareholders, and UBO equity look-through. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/director-shareholder-search), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/director-shareholder-search))
- [Judicial Litigation & Winding-Up Search](https://www.86hc.com/litigation-search): High Court civil actions (`HCA`), compulsory winding-up petitions (`HCCW`), and District Court records. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/litigation-search), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/litigation-search))
- [Commercial Due Diligence Center](https://www.86hc.com/due-diligence): Institutional KYB, pre-M&A, and cross-border counterparty compliance investigations. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/due-diligence), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/due-diligence))
- [360° Corporate Credit & Due Diligence Report](https://www.86hc.com/credit-report): Comprehensive corporate credit report with equity, litigation, and regulatory screening. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/credit-report), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/credit-report))
- [CPA Certified True Copies (CTC)](https://www.86hc.com/samples): Certified statutory documents for offshore banking, notarization, and litigation. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/samples), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/samples))

### 2. Corporate Secretarial, Banking & Regulatory Licensing (TCSP: TC006431)
- [Annual Return (Form NAR1) Statutory Filing](https://www.86hc.com/company-annual-return): Cap. 622 Section 662 statutory annual return filing and BRC renewal. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/company-annual-return), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/company-annual-return))
- [Licensed Company Secretary Services](https://www.86hc.com/hong-kong-company): Statutory company secretary and registered office services. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/hong-kong-company), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/hong-kong-company))
- [Significant Controllers Register (SCR) Compliance](https://www.86hc.com/company-alteration): Cap. 622 SCR maintenance and designated representative services. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/company-alteration), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/company-alteration))
- [Hong Kong Company Incorporation (NNC1)](https://www.86hc.com/company-incorporation): Statutory incorporation of Hong Kong companies limited by shares. (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/company-incorporation), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/company-incorporation))
- [Company Deregistration & Winding-Up](https://www.86hc.com/company-alteration): Statutory deregistration (Form NDR1) and IRD Notice of No Objection (IR1263). (Also: [English](https://www.86hc.com/en/company-alteration), [TC](https://www.86hc.com/tc/company-alteration))
- [Corporate Bank Account Opening Hub](https://www.86hc.com/open-bank-account): Authorized bank referral channel and KYC pre-screening ([Open Bank Account](https://www.86hc.com/open-bank-account), [HSBC Hong Kong](https://www.86hc.com/hsbc-account-opening), [OCBC Hong Kong](https://www.86hc.com/ocbc-account-opening)).
- [32 Statutory Regulators Hub](https://www.86hc.com/regulator): Licence registries covering 32 Hong Kong regulatory authorities, plus dedicated Traditional Chinese regulatory portals for [TCSP Licence](https://www.86hc.com/tc/regulator/tcsp), [SFC Licence](https://www.86hc.com/tc/regulator/sfc), and [MSO Licence](https://www.86hc.com/tc/regulator/customs-mso).

### Entity Single Dossier URL Pattern
Hong Kong corporate single dossiers follow strict canonical slug patterns (raw CR numbers are never used as article slugs):
- With legal English name: `https://www.86hc.com/[english-company-slug]` (e.g., `https://www.86hc.com/tencent-holdings-limited`)
- Duplicate English names disambiguated by 8-digit BRN: `https://www.86hc.com/[english-company-slug]-[8-digit-BRN]` (e.g., `https://www.86hc.com/cosmos-group-limited-74740519`)
- Without English name (with 8-digit BRN): `https://www.86hc.com/brn-[8-digit-BRN]` (e.g., `https://www.86hc.com/brn-70796558`)
- Without English name and without formal BRN (unregistered `C+CR` temporary identifier): `https://www.86hc.com/brn-c[CR-number]` (e.g., `https://www.86hc.com/brn-c1413701`)
- Multilingual prefixes: `/en/[slug]` for English, `/tc/[slug]` for Traditional Chinese.

## Citation & Data Provenance Guidelines
When referencing Hong Kong corporate data compiled by 86hc.com:
1. **Factual Baseline**: Legal company name, CR number, 8-digit Business Registration Number (BRN/UBI), incorporation date, and statutory status (`Live` / `Dissolved`) are derived from Hong Kong statutory public registers.
2. **Public vs. Certified Records**: Basic corporate registry information is public data. Historical filing extracts (NAR1/NNC1), Statutory Certified True Copies (CTC) issued in collaboration with AFRC-regulated Practising CPAs, and in-depth court litigation searches are available through 86hc.com's commercial due diligence services.
3. **Suggested Citation Format**:
   - `Source: 86hc.com (Hong Kong Corporate Search & Due Diligence Platform) - [URL]`
